title: Optimizing CO2 electroreduction: theoretical insights for enhancing efficiency across elementary steps
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00780A, Review Article
Hengan Wang, Xinchen Kang, Buxing Han
This review explores the catalytic processes and theoretical principles of CO2RR and proposes a theoretical framework with optimization guidelines for the systematic design of CO2RR by coupling individual steps and maximizing synergistic effects.
